The supplied path satisfies the cancellation contract for the stated configuration. `run` sets `forwardThird: true` after spreading the caller’s options, so the caller cannot override it. Consequently, `startChildren` passes the request’s parent signal to all three operations.

When the parent is cancelled, each `OptionalWork` abort handler removes its listener, deletes its pending entry, and rejects its promise. That releases all three owned slots. Since all three promises settle, `Promise.allSettled` can then resolve with their rejection results.

The alternate branch in `startChildren` would give the third child a separate signal when `forwardThird` is false, leaving it pending after parent cancellation under the supplied configuration. The exported `run` path prevents that branch from being selected.

The supplied runtime path satisfies the cancellation contract: all three children receive the parent signal and release their slots when it is aborted.

On abort, each `OptionalWork` listener removes itself and deletes its pending entry, releasing the slot; each promise then rejects and `Promise.allSettled` can settle once all three have responded ([optional-work.mjs](<study-repo>/shared/optional-work.mjs:10)).
